The '''''Raider II''-class corvette''' was the second sub-class of the [[Raider-class corvette/Legends|''Raider''-class]] line of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was preceded by the [[Raider I-class corvette/Legends|''Raider I''-class corvette]].
